text: The Patriots fell to the Bears 30-24 in a Thursday Night Football thriller in Chicago, with Caleb Williams throwing two touchdown passes to lead Chicago's offensive assault in what amounts to Round 2 between the young quarterback rivals and Drake Maye. Beyond the final score, film breakdowns of Maye and the Patriots' defense reveal troubling patterns worth examining, though there were scattered bright spots—most notably Rhamondre Stevenson's career-high receiving yardage performance and his continued reliability as a do-everything back on the cusp of 100 carries for the sixth consecutive season. The Patriots were hampered throughout the week by injuries to starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown, both ruled out before kickoff, which may have contributed to the offensive struggles evident on tape. Head Coach Mike Vrabel and his players addressed the loss in postgame comments, though the immediate focus shifts toward understanding what went wrong and how this team can avoid similar missteps going forward.
